# Nexa

> Drop-in OpenAI / Anthropic API gateway. One key, 9 providers (Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Doubao, Mistral, Gemini), 15% off official rates, with a Claude OAuth account pool that prices Claude Sonnet/Opus at ~50% of the API.

Nexa is a relay for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cline, Cursor, OpenCode). The gateway accepts both Anthropic-shaped /v1/messages and OpenAI-shaped /v1/chat/completions on every model. Prompt caching, tool calls, and streaming are byte-passthrough. Wallet-based billing with per-key day/week/month spending caps. Zero prompt retention server-side.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs): tool-by-tool integration guides
- [Claude Code](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/claude-code): the primary client config
- [Cline](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/cline): VSCode extension setup
- [Cursor](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/cursor): editor config in OpenAI-compat mode
- [Raw API](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/api): curl examples for /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions
- [SDK setup](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/sdk): OpenAI / Anthropic SDK config in Python and Node, plus an in-page Try-it
- [API Reference](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/api-reference): interactive Scalar reference, OpenAPI 3.1
- [Cost guide](https://claude.xxflk.cn/docs/cost-guide): model picking + charging formula

## OpenAPI

- [openapi.json](https://claude.xxflk.cn/openapi.json): full OpenAPI 3.1 spec for /v1/* endpoints

## Marketing pages

- [Pricing](https://claude.xxflk.cn/pricing): public per-model rates + volume rebate tiers

- [Status](https://claude.xxflk.cn/status): live probes against gateway, DB, cache, and per-provider state

## Public endpoints

- `GET /healthz`: liveness probe (always 200 if process is up)
- `GET /readyz`: readiness probe with DB + Redis subchecks
- `GET /version`: build version + commit
- `GET /v1/status`: aggregated status feed used by /status — JSON, cache-control 15s
- `GET /v1/catalog`: provider-grouped model catalog with prices, cache-control 60s
- `GET /v1/pricing`: flat list of all model prices, cache-control 60s

## Quotas and pricing

- 15% discount over official prices on every model
- $5 welcome credit on signup (no card required)
- Volume rebates: Bronze (3% on $500+/mo) · Silver (5% on $2k+/mo) · Gold (7% on $5k+/mo) · Platinum (10% on $20k+/mo)
- Per-key caps: day / week / month, in USD; gateway returns 402 instead of forwarding once cap is hit
